$comment: M13. The first half of an arrival page: getting there, and the room. The company sheet that follows says who is there and closes the page. Holes: establish (form short: the card's short form), weather (tonight's sky on the way in), prop (a place-ambient card; bind prop to put a thing in the room the page can bring back; form bind draws it silently for the sheet text to say). Slots: {place}, {Place}, {prop}, {prop.text}, {prop.near}. The golden is docs/golden/sheets-arrival.md, Sheet A.

sheets.name: The place, and one thing in it
sheets.notes: Sheet A's first half, the blessed golden: the establish card whole, then a place-ambient card that puts a prop in the room (pam-102, the mirror).

sheets.name: The first thing you noticed
sheets.notes: Sheet B's first half: the establish card's short form, and the prop said as the first thing anybody sees. Needs a prop the room has not shown tonight.

parts.text: The first thing you noticed was {prop.text}.

sheets.name: In from the night
sheets.notes: Sheet C's first half: the short form, with the night on the way in, and the room left to the people in it.

sheets.name: The night, then the place
sheets.notes: Tonight's weather on the way in, the establish card whole, and a thing in the room.
